description: Advanced TidGen Power System - LCOE Calculations and System Overview is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Cian Marnagh, Jarlath McEntee. The TidGen Power System generates emission-free electricity from tidal currents and connects directly into existing grids using smart grid technology. The power system consists of three major subsystems: shore-side power electronics, mooring system, and turbine generator unit (TGU) device. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
